# Blue Fox Landscape & Services

> Landscaping, pressure washing and soft washing company serving Central Florida.
> "Professional Landscaping, Pressure Washing & Soft Washing In Central Florida."

## Contact
- Office: 407-717-8191
- After hours: 407-969-7137
- Email: bluefoxlandscapeandservices@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9am–5pm. Saturday and Sunday closed.
- Instagram: @bluefox_landscape_services
- Based in Lake Mary, Florida. No street address is published.

## Service area
Established: Lake Mary, Heathrow, Altamonte Springs, Longwood and Orlando, Florida.
Extended, availability confirmed per address before booking: Winter Park, Winter
Garden, Windermere and Ocoee.

## Landscaping services
- Landscape design & construction — a member of the design team meets you to get
  your vision, then creates a rendering of the finished product before installation.
- Sod installation — a landscaper evaluates the lawn and advises whether new sod is
  the right course of action. Residential and commercial.
- Paver installation — driveways, walkways, patios and more. Commercial and residential.
- Irrigation — installation, repair and maintenance.
- Tree & hedge work — trees and stumps removed, plus tree and hedge trimming.
- Landscape lighting — exterior lighting installation.
- Drainage — systems that direct rain and irrigation runoff away from the property,
  after a free evaluation.

## Washing services
- Exterior window washing — outside glass, frames and sills.
- Interior window washing — inside glass and sills.
- Power washing (high pressure, hard surfaces) — driveways and walkways, patio and
  deck, fence and gate.
- House washing (soft wash) — siding, soffits, eaves and trim.
- Gutter cleaning (soft wash) — build-up of leaves, mold, dirt and grime removed.
- Solar panel cleaning — pollen, dust and droppings removed from the panels.
- Roof washing (soft wash only) — a roof must never be pressure washed, because high
  pressure strips shingle granules and drives water under the courses.

Soft washing is a method — low pressure plus cleaning solutions — not a separate
service; it is how houses, gutters and roofs are cleaned.

## Pricing
Estimates are free. The single published fee: as of 7/1/2023 landscape digital design
work costs $250.00, with a 50% deposit required. If the landscape package is approved,
the $250.00 is credited toward the landscape project. No unit pricing is published for
any other service.

## Financing
Available through Acorn Finance — apply once and get payment options from multiple
lenders. Rates, terms and amounts are set by the lenders.
